## Contribution provenance

- [ ] Every human-submitted commit is signed off under the Developer Certificate of Origin (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] I have the right to submit all code, data, text, and media in this change.
- [ ] Third-party material is identified with its source and license.
- [ ] No confidential, personal, employer-restricted, sponsor-restricted, or publisher-restricted material is included.
- [ ] The applicable license scope in `LICENSE_SCOPE.md` is preserved.

## Research integrity

- [ ] Claim boundaries, negative results, seeds, manifests, and hashes remain accurate.
- [ ] Relevant tests and publication audits pass.
- [ ] Documentation and citation metadata are updated when required.
